title.en: Electric 15 or Electric 10 Series on a small site?
title.zh: 小型工地选电动15还是电动10系列？

description.en: Electric 15 prints vertical 15–20 m and horizontal 60–80 m at 8–10 m³/h. Electric 10 Series prints only 25 m horizontal at 21 m³/h. Both are 15 kW rural rows.
description.zh: 电动15印垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、8–10 m³/h。电动10系列只印水平 25 m、21 m³/h。两台都是 15 kW 的农村行。

h1.en: Electric 15 or Electric 10 Series on a small site?
h1.zh: 小型工地选电动15还是电动10系列？

directAnswer.en: Use Electric 10 Series when the only distance you can cite is within 25 m horizontal and the stone is 2 cm and below. Use Electric 15 when you need the printed vertical 15–20 m or horizontal 60–80 m and the stone is 1–3 cm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai gives both the rural, small-site and secondary-structure sentence. Output is 21 m³/h on the 10 Series and 8–10 m³/h on Electric 15. The higher output is the shorter horizontal machine.
directAnswer.zh: 你能引用的距离只有水平 25 m 以内、石子在 2 cm 及以下时，用电动10系列。需要已印的垂直 15–20 m 或水平 60–80 m、石子是 1–3 cm 时，用电动15。邢台河北品锦机械给两台都写了农村、小型工地和二次结构。10系列输送量是 21 m³/h，电动15是 8–10 m³/h。输送量更高的那台，水平更短。

heading.en: Pressure is printed on only one of them

body.en: Electric 10 Series prints 23 MPa and hopper 0.1 m³. Electric 15 does not print outlet pressure or a hopper cell. Weight is 400 kg versus 450 kg. Pipe diameter is printed on Electric 15 as 100–125 mm and is not in the Electric 10 Series list used here.
body.zh: 电动10系列印了 23 MPa 和料斗 0.1 m³。电动15没有印出口压力，也没有料斗格。重量是 400 kg 对 450 kg。管径在电动15上是 100–125 mm，这里使用的电动10系列清单里没有这一格。

heading.en: A small site can still leave both
heading.zh: 小型工地仍可能离开两台

body.en: Beyond 60–80 m horizontal, or when the commercial sentence applies, open Electric 20 (120 m / 40 m, 80 mm, 1–2 cm). Beyond 5 m but inside a 380 V tight plot with 5–16 mm stone, the selection guide also offers B500S-83D. Do not stretch either 15 kW table to cover that 5 m machine or the Electric 20 building row.
body.zh: 水平超过 60–80 m，或已经适用商业那句话时，打开电动20（120 m / 40 m、80 mm、1–2 cm）。超过 5 m 但仍是 380 V 狭小场地、石子 5–16 mm 时，选型指南还提供 B500S-83D。不要把两张 15 kW 的表拉去覆盖那台 5 m 的机器或电动20的建筑行。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say which distance you measured: 25 m horizontal, or the Electric 15 pair. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请说明你量到的是水平 25 m，还是电动15那一对距离。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.zh: 两台都允许 3 cm 石子吗？

answer.en: Electric 15 prints 1–3 cm. Electric 10 Series prints 2 cm and below.
answer.zh: 电动15印 1–3 cm。电动10系列印 2 cm 及以下。

answer.en: No. Both need a supply for 15 kW.
answer.zh: 都不是。两台都需要能供给 15 kW 的电源。
